purpose: Reviewer-requested task utility and sample-size diagnostics; no core algorithm changes

numeric.external_mechanism: diffprivlib.mechanisms.Laplace 0.6.6; numerical uniform allocation; same clipped input, public bounds and postprocessing; categorical outputs supplied by unchanged RUPA GRR
numeric.primary_metric: median over numerical fields of absolute total relative error, percent
secondary_metrics: cross-region share absolute error in percentage points
numeric.comparison: paired seeds for RUPA-component methods; external sampler has different random draws; bootstrap CI of paired mean differences is descriptive, no allocation-superiority claim

sample_size.subset_rule: nested prefix after SHA256(public_registration_id + fixed salt) sorting; calibration unchanged
sample_size.primary_metric: maximum of the two marginal absolute coverage errors after public GRR decoding, percentage points
sample_size.estimator: unclipped inverse GRR; out-of-range estimates retained and reported
sample_size.scope: two binary attributes only; no high-cardinality or confidential deployment claim
